core_problem_solved: To provide the complete Apache HBase distributed database system in a single, monolithic artifact, including both client and server components.
key_features: Contained all classes for running HBase servers (Master, RegionServer) and for connecting as a client to the cluster.
era_and_niche: The original, legacy artifact for early versions of HBase, before the project was properly modularized for better dependency management.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete** due to **modularization**. The HBase project was split into multiple, more granular modules to provide better separation of concerns. Applications that need to connect to an HBase cluster should now depend on the **`org.apache.hbase:hbase-client`** artifact instead.
